title: Pre-action hook contract v1: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the hook request and response schemas of contract version 1.

reason_code.description: Stable, non-sensitive reason code; longer values are ignored.

ProudAuth-Hook-Version.description: Hook contract version of the request (the hook registration's contract_version). A response may echo it; an echoed value other than the request's makes the response malformed.

Webhook-Id.description: Unique message ID of this call (hkm_ + 26 characters). Different on every call.

Webhook-Timestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the call was signed.

Webhook-Signature.description: "v1," + base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, Webhook-Id + "." + Webhook-Timestamp + "." + raw body)), key = base64-decoded signing secret after the "hksec_" prefix.
